description.zh: 目标端数据源类型，不填代表不限制，枚举值：Hologres，OSS-HDFS，OSS，MaxCompute，LogHub，StarRocks，DataHub，AnalyticDB_For_MySQL，Kafka，Hive。
description.en: The type of the destination data source. If you do not specify this parameter, jobs are not filtered by this criterion. Valid values: `Hologres`, `OSS-HDFS`, `OSS`, `MaxCompute`, `LogHub`, `StarRocks`, `DataHub`, `AnalyticDB_For_MySQL`, `Kafka`, and `Hive`.

description.zh:
同步类型，可选的枚举值有：
- FullAndRealtimeIncremental（全量和实时增量）
- RealtimeIncremental（实时增量）
- Full（全量）
- OfflineIncremental（离线增量）
- FullAndOfflineIncremental（全量+离线增量）
description.en:
The synchronization type. Valid values:

- `FullAndRealtimeIncremental`: full and real-time incremental synchronization

- `RealtimeIncremental`: real-time incremental synchronization

- `Full`: full synchronization

- `OfflineIncremental`: offline incremental synchronization

- `FullAndOfflineIncremental`: full and offline incremental synchronization

description.zh:
导出任务的名称。

名称必须唯一，即当前DataWorks工作空间中不能存在名称重复的导出任务。
description.en:
The name of the Data Integration job.

The name must be unique within the DataWorks workspace.
The page number. Pages are numbered starting from 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 每页显示的数据条数，默认为10条，最大为100条。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default: 10. Maximum: 100.
The ID of the DataWorks workspace.

description.zh: 源端数据源类型，不填代表不限制，枚举值：PolarDB，MySQL，Kafka，LogHub，Hologres，Oracle，OceanBase，MongoDB，RedShift，Hive，SQLServer，Doris，ClickHouse。
description.en: The type of the source data source. If you do not specify this parameter, jobs are not filtered by this criterion. Valid values: `PolarDB`, `MySQL`, `Kafka`, `LogHub`, `Hologres`, `Oracle`, `OceanBase`, `MongoDB`, `RedShift`, `Hive`, `SQLServer`, `Doris`, and `ClickHouse`.

description.zh: 任务配置规范类型。可选FILESPEC、CLASSIC、ALL。FILESPEC：基于结构化 filespec 的新版任务；CLASSIC：传统配置模式的任务；
description.en: The configuration type of the job. Valid values: `FILESPEC`, `CLASSIC`, and `ALL`. `FILESPEC` indicates a new job type configured based on a structured file specification. `CLASSIC` indicates a job configured in the traditional mode. If you set this parameter to `ALL`, jobs of both types are returned.

title.zh: 获取数据集成同步任务配置列表

descriptions.zh: 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用。
descriptions.en: This operation requires DataWorks Basic Edition or a later edition.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-di-jobs --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --name test_export_01 --source-data-source-type MySQL --destination-data-source-type Hologres --migration-type FullAndRealtimeIncremental --project-id 1967 --spec-type example-string --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListDIJobs --region cn-hangzhou --DestinationDataSourceType Hologres --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SpecType 'example-string' --SourceDataSourceType MySQL --ProjectId 1967 --MigrationType FullAndRealtimeIncremental --Name test_export_01
